algorithm: FIPS 204 ML-DSA-65, pure interface (ML-DSA.Sign / ML-DSA.Verify with a context string)

cases.name: baseline
cases.note: reference transfer, nonce 0, signed by key A

cases.name: nonce_1
cases.note: only the nonce differs: v1 digest is IDENTICAL to baseline (the H0-4 replay), the v2 preimage differs

cases.name: id_changed
cases.note: only the id differs

cases.name: sender_changed
cases.note: only the sender differs

cases.name: gas_limit_changed
cases.note: only gas_limit differs

cases.name: chain_id_changed
cases.note: only the chain id differs

cases.name: body_changed
cases.note: different body (Burn)

cases.name: unit_variant_body
cases.note: body that serialises as a bare string

cases.name: signer_b
cases.note: a different key signs; the key field in the preimage is key B

cases.name: max_nonce
cases.note: nonce = u64::MAX

cases.name: max_gas_limit
cases.note: gas_limit = u64::MAX

cases.name: empty_id
cases.note: empty id is encodable (length 0)

cases.name: unicode_id
cases.note: non-ASCII id, UTF-8 bytes

cases.name: adjacent_fields_a
cases.note: id='ab', sender='c' (prefix-freeness pair, part 1)

cases.name: adjacent_fields_b
cases.note: id='a', sender='bc' (prefix-freeness pair, part 2): different preimage from part 1

cases.name: replay_nonce_changed
cases.note: baseline signature over a preimage whose nonce was changed to 1 (the H0-4 attack)

cases.name: replay_id_changed
cases.note: baseline signature, id changed

cases.name: replay_sender_changed
cases.note: baseline signature, sender changed

cases.name: replay_gas_changed
cases.note: baseline signature, gas_limit changed

cases.name: replay_chain_changed
cases.note: baseline signature, chain id changed (cross-chain replay)

cases.name: replay_body_changed
cases.note: baseline signature, body changed

cases.name: replay_key_field_changed
cases.note: baseline signature, but the preimage names key B (signed by A)

cases.name: signature_bit_flipped
cases.note: one bit flipped in the baseline signature

cases.name: signature_by_other_key
cases.note: signed by key B, verified against key A

cases.name: context_consensus_vote
cases.note: signature made over the same preimage in context b'qattice/consensus/vote/v1'; verified as a transaction (context qattice/tx/v2)

cases.name: context_empty_context
cases.note: signature made over the same preimage in context b''; verified as a transaction (context qattice/tx/v2)

cases.name: context_transaction_v1_name
cases.note: signature made over the same preimage in context b'qattice/tx/v1'; verified as a transaction (context qattice/tx/v2)

cases.name: context_max_length_context
cases.note: signature made over the same preimage in context b'AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA'...; verified as a transaction (context qattice/tx/v2)

cases.name: context_tx_signature_as_vote
cases.note: the baseline TRANSACTION signature verified in the consensus-vote context

envelope_cases.name: accept_first_use
envelope_cases.note: valid envelope, unbound sender, key carried

envelope_cases.name: accept_bound_key_omitted
envelope_cases.note: valid envelope, key already bound, tx omits the key

envelope_cases.name: accept_bound_key_repeated
envelope_cases.note: valid envelope, key already bound, tx repeats the same key

envelope_cases.name: reject_slhdsa
envelope_cases.note: SLH-DSA tag (no live verifier, not allowed)

envelope_cases.name: reject_ed25519_signature_present
envelope_cases.note: ML-DSA tag but an Ed25519 signature rides along

envelope_cases.name: reject_ed25519_key_present
envelope_cases.note: ML-DSA tag but an Ed25519 public key rides along

envelope_cases.name: reject_first_use_short_key
envelope_cases.note: unbound sender, key one byte short

envelope_cases.name: reject_key_differs_from_bound
envelope_cases.note: bound key present, tx carries a different key

note: Keys are derived from fixed public seeds with FIPS 204 KeyGen_internal; they are TEST keys, never to be used elsewhere. Signatures are deterministic (rnd = 0^32), produced by an independent pure-Python FIPS 204 implementation.
